claim_label: AI Productivity Boost in Customer Support
description: Access to a generative AI conversational assistant increased customer support agent productivity by 15% on average, as measured by issues resolved per hour.

instances.assertion: Access to a generative AI conversational assistant increased customer support agent productivity by 15% on average, as measured by issues resolved per hour.
Generative AI assistance increased worker productivity by 15% on average in a customer support setting.
